reason: Start a fresh exclusive warm ROS2 Jazzy/Gazebo environment for the revised full-robot detachable A/B diagnostic. The diagnostic now declares the static world anchor before the robot model so DetachableJoint can resolve its child model during plugin configuration; it also reports per-joint A/B and combined chassis-hold/arm-motion failure classes. Target commit 916e2463b6c5ddab2f7b4694987c8b399e733bb9.
